citations.context: The devotional pill is used as emotional framing. It's comfort over context. Instead of digging into history, genre, or cultural background, the love letter approach highlights verses that sound warm and affirming. So Zephaniah chapter 3, verse 17 says, He will rejoice over you with singing. Now, in context, this is about Israel's national restoration. In devotionals, it's lifted out of that context as a tender image. God sings lullabies over me in the United States of America, in Alabama.
citations.creator: darante-lamar
citations.title: The Bible Is a Love Letter? No… It’s a Threat

text.KJV: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
text.WEB: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

citations.context: But if it's the only nation that it has happened to, specifically their ancestral homeland, 2,000 years out of it, and God foretold it, there's got to be a strength there. And even the language being restored. Zephaniah 3 9 says, For then I will restore to the people a pure language that they may call on my name, the name of the Lord to serve him with one accord. Now, the language, the Hebrew language disappeared except in religious settings.
